setup: Close above previous 55 highs, relative quote volume >=2, close>SMA200, EMA20>EMA50, close>EMA20, strong close top30%, extension<=4%, 1h change<6%, finite simple-smoothed ADX14>=30.
entry: Only first EMA20 touch in the following 16 bars. Keep close >= original breakout level minus 0.5 setup ATR and above EMA50. Within 4 bars after touch, close above previous high with trend, strong close, rvol>=1.25. One signal per setup; new breakouts do not replace an active setup.
exit: Stop 2ATR clamped1-5%; half off2R, net-cost breakeven then trail1R. No entries after23:00UTC; flatten23:45UTC or first fresh quote after an outage. Max24h. No leverage or averaging down.
evaluation: Independent daily300USDT trials for2024,2025,Jan-Sep2026 at base and stress costs from protocol.json; no parameter search. Past data is exploratory reused data, NOT untouched holdout.
deployment: Isolated seven-day forward paper account only; keep main approval null regardless of reused historical outcomes. Telegram must label this account. No automatic promotion or capital reset.
attribution: Original intraday adaptation of breakout/first-pullback/volatility-risk concepts, not a reproduction or endorsement of any trader. Simple rolling ADX, no stock news gaps, no shorting, no Turtle pyramiding. Brandt discretionary chart patterns are not claimed implemented.
